triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: She will remember Mitya Karamazov sometimes, she will see how Mitya loved her, she will feel for Mitya!

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: Here we see in excess a love of effect, a romantic despair and sentimentality, and the wild recklessness of the Karamazovs.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: He ran for the pistols he had left in pledge with his friend Perhotin

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: I cannot otherwise explain the disappearance of quite half of the three thousand he had just taken from his father’s pillow.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: His first compromising exclamations he hastened to explain by declaring that he was responsible for the death of the servant Grigory only.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: He had been in Mokroe more than once before, he had caroused there for two days together already, he knew the old big house with all its passages and outbuildings.
